title: ewf-pl-tagteam
label: Vaclav & Izzy Nilsen

won.source: This wing's newly served show script for EWF Wrestlepalooza XCII (14 December 2008): Vaclav and Izzy Nilsen (with a run-in from Backstabber) pin Jupiter and Chris "More" Attitude to win the EWF Tag Team titles.

how: Backstabber's run-in helped Vaclav pin Chris "More" Attitude
note: The predecessor reign (Jupiter & Chris "More" Attitude, champions entering this match) is not independently dated in the held record -- the title-history page's own capture (May 2007) predates it, and no other document records when they won the belts.

title: ewf-pl-tagteam
label: Nas Jazzowski & Y2J

won.source: This wing's newly served show script for EWF Wrestlepalooza XCVIII (31 May 2009): commissioner Szakal disqualifies Tool mid-match and substitutes Y2J, who teams with Nas Jazzowski to pin Vaclav and Izzy Nilsen for the EWF Tag Team titles.

how: Nas Jazzowski pinned Vaclav after Y2J (subbed in for a DQ'd Tool by commissioner decree) had softened him up

title: ewf-pl-ftw
label: Psycho

won.source: This wing's newly served show script for EWF Wrestlepalooza XCVII (5 April 2009): Psycho pins stand-in defending champion Vaclav (wrestling in place of an injured Jupiter, per commissioner Felipe Castro's own ruling earlier in the same show) in a triple threat also involving Shambler, and is congratulated by name on winning the EWF FTW title in Esmeralda Martinez's own closing announcements.

how: Pinned substitute defending champion Vaclav (standing in for an injured Jupiter) in a triple threat also involving Shambler
note: Jupiter's own reign as the champion entering this show is not independently dated in the held record -- he is already billed "(c)" at the 30 November 2008 show, after Yamato Konoe's own attested 2007 reign, with no document recording when or how he regained the belt.

title: ewf-pl-ftw
label: Psycho (2) & Tool

won.source: This wing's newly served show script for EWF Wrestlepalooza XCIX (27 June 2009): a no-referee backstage title match between champion Psycho and Tool ends in a simultaneous double pin; commissioner Szakal, refusing to allow a title vacancy, declares both men EWF FTW Champions and confiscates the belt.

how: Double pin (no finish); commissioner Szakal declared both men co-champions

title: ewf-pl-ftw
label: Nas Jazzowski

won.source: This wing's newly served show script for the EWF HD "Aborcja" card (26 July 2009): Nas Jazzowski pins Tool -- billed "(c)" alone, the co-championship with Psycho unaddressed -- after special guest referee Szakal turns on Tool with his own finisher.

note: Tool alone defended the title in this match; whether Psycho's share of the r030 co-championship formally ended is not stated in any document this collection holds.
